limitations: This packet constructs the normalized determinant-of-cohomology anchor lambda_det(F) as a Pic^0(E)-valued map.
It verifies the degree-zero normalization and determinant-functor base-change needed for a morphism to the Picard functor.
It does not compute the E-translation weight; that row is separated in certificates/hybrid/determinant_anchor_translation_weight.
It does not pass to a finite cover to make unit translation weight.
It does not handle chi(F)=0 degeneracy; that row is separated in certificates/hybrid/determinant_anchor_chi_zero_degeneracy.
It does not add the Jordan-Hoelder extra-anchor data; that row is separated in certificates/hybrid/determinant_anchor_extra_anchor_data.
It does not define the anchor residual; that row is separated in certificates/hybrid/anchor_residual_definition.
It does not prove o_R^lambda=0, prove losslessness, prove quotient descent, or prove transition compatibility.
